Name: Emily's Magic Hat
Author: SiTheGreat1
Description:
Get Emily's Magic Hat without marrying her!
In vanilla, you get the hat by viewing her 14-heart event. With this mod, she'll send it to you once you've collected all the Golden Walnuts on Ginger Island.
The config lets you adjust the number of Golden Walnuts needed for her to send it to you to whatever number you want, so you don't have to collect all of them if you'd prefer something easier.
Can be added to preexisting saves; if you've already collected all the Golden Walnuts before installing you might need to sleep a night for the letter to appear.
This mod will send you the hat regardless of whether or not you romance her, and if you do, then you'll still get the one in her 14-heart event as well.
Should be compatible with any other mods (including SVE) but let me know if you find any issues.
Should be compatible with both pre-1.6.9 and post-1.6.9 saves.
